action.message: Always treat state-ledger writes (task updates, IPC replies, commits of agent edits) as blocking obligations that execute immediately after completing a unit of work — never batch them as end-of-session cleanup, especially during high-parallelism periods.

Always ask 'what does this system emit for input it has never seen?' when building or reviewing any gate, extractor, or fallback path — if the answer is a plausible-looking value rather than an explicit failure, redesign the default.
